facts.fact: 决赛中两兽互撕但眼里全是悲哀——它们不想打
facts.anchor: Andra couldn’t help but notice the sorrow in their eyes with every collision. They didn’t want this.

facts.fact: 上层连环爆炸掀她撞柱；绳索垂降两名蒙面人
facts.anchor: explosion after explosion ignited around the upper level of the structure, and Andra was knocked headfirst into a pillar.

facts.fact: 蒙面人四十尺落地稳如排练；抬手近兽示非攻击
facts.anchor: two men propelled quickly down the ropes, landing gracefully in the dirt as if they hadn’t just fallen forty feet.

facts.fact: 她被裙摆绊倒——地裂魔法被蓝眼蒙面人看在眼里
facts.anchor: One of the men turned just as Andra tripped over her skirts at least twenty feet away.

facts.fact: Jasper 捂嘴把她拖回帷幔后——掼进暗巷拧脱肩关节捆手
facts.anchor: Andra tried to scream but Jasper wrapped a hand around her mouth and hauled her back behind the tapestry.

facts.fact: 恨意账单：被羞辱/孤立/转而敌视——“女人该知道自己的位置”
facts.anchor: Humiliated me.” He slammed her head against the wall. “Ostracized me. Turned them against me.

facts.fact: 供出：与 Hachar 计划蜂蜜酒下药明早拍卖她——“我自己了结你”
facts.anchor: Hachar and I had plans to slip something into your mead and auction you off in the morning.

facts.fact: 刀割腹部渗血+手伸向大腿——她被布堵嘴无力反抗
facts.anchor: The blade dug into Andra’s skin just enough for a drop of blood to trail down her abdomen, and Jasper laughed

facts.fact: 两兽扑咬 Jasper 至无法辨认——她不敢看又渴望看
facts.anchor: She watched until Jasper’s body was nothing more than an unidentifiable bloody mess in a deserted alleyway.

facts.fact: 哑巴哥哥手语交流——蓝眼弟弟口译；“有人得救它们”
facts.anchor: His mouth remained closed, but his hands rapidly formed various shapes and movements in the space between them

facts.fact: 人群中 Lucas 救伤——她望着他决定撒谎“没看到他”
facts.anchor: Lucas rushed between the fallen, offering aid or advice when he could, before moving on to the next.

facts.fact: 蓝眼男说去北边客栈=Traveler's Inn——她抢在勇气漏光前问“能跟你们走吗”
facts.anchor: Her thoughts raced, and she acted before she lost the courage. “Can I come with you?
